segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: “That your body had finally become too small for the amount of responsibility you were acquiring.”

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
That shut me up.

Ithar's eye narrowed slightly.

segments.speaker: ithar
segments.transcript: “You could stand in the healer's room or Rope Street. Not both. Your authority could. You are describing the first time you noticed it arriving somewhere ahead of you.”

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
I hated that sentence.

Mostly because it was useful.

“So I wrote the sheet better.”

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
The memory took me back to the table.

The next week I changed the private work sheet.

STOP AUTHORITY.

Any worker on the job could isolate service for an observed immediate hazard.

OPEN AUTHORITY.

Limited opening allowed if delay increased risk, with client notice where practical.

CALL AUTHORITY.

If I was not present, Lorn could request district assistance under the contract number.

Lorn read it.

“You made me paperwork.”

“Yes.”

“Can I quit?”

“No.”

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
“That is probably illegal.”

“Then file a complaint.”

“I know where you live.”

“So does Senn.”

That complaint reached Guild Hall two weeks later.

Of course it did.

The Guild notice required testimony.

PRIVATE WORK REVIEW.

CLIENT DISPUTE.

WORKER CONDUCT.

Lorn read it over my shoulder.

“You getting fined?”

“We.”

His face changed.

“No.”

“Yes.”

“You signed the contract.”

“You opened the wall.”

“You told me I was right.”

“You were.”

“Then why am I going?”

segments.speaker: greg
segments.transcript:
“Because being right apparently does not eliminate procedure.”

He looked at the notice.

Then at me.

“You going to tell them I did what you said?”

“No.”

“Good.”

The answer came too fast.

Lorn heard it.

So did I.

My contract.

My worker.

My responsibility.

All true.

Incomplete.

Lorn had made the call.

“I'll tell them what I wrote,” I said.

“And I tell them what I did.”

“Yes.”

“What if they decide I fucked it?”

“Then we learn something expensive.”
